constraints.description: No stored recipes or ratios. Use fresh live tools. Preserve native mechanics, owner structures, committed semantics, reservations and harness recovery limits. Reconcile uncertain effects before further mutation.

guidance.when_to_use: A supported route or operating profile must fit available service and protection.
guidance.when_to_skip: No travel is authorized or route/profile controls are unavailable.
live_checks: Live route conditions, operating supply, defensive capacity and actual consumption.
Supported schedule/profile changes and owner destination/time constraints.
steps: Read the conditions of the intended route and the limits of the commissioned platform.
Choose only a supported operating profile whose observed supply and protection can sustain it.
Verify the authorized arrival and remaining operating capability; an untested route remains a proposal.
completion: The requested route completes within its acceptance conditions with usable continuing service.
required_capabilities: Admitted route/schedule/profile control and relevant hazard/consumption telemetry.

known_failure_modes: Faster travel is assumed better while it outruns supply or protection.
Route safety is inferred from static construction alone.

basis: Authored decision procedure; use requires live applicability and supported tools. Difficulty is independent of evidence. No autonomous gameplay capability is established.

skills.name: Plan Cargo by Delivered Value
skills.summary: Cargo capacity or delivery preparation constrains a useful milestone. The useful shipment reaches its intended destination without starving required origin service.

preconditions.subject: live-applicability
preconditions.description: Check live capability, current goal, actor/surface and tool availability; an entry does not grant execution or plan authority.

constraints.description: No stored recipes or ratios. Use fresh live tools. Preserve native mechanics, owner structures, committed semantics, reservations and harness recovery limits. Reconcile uncertain effects before further mutation.

guidance.when_to_use: Cargo capacity or delivery preparation constrains a useful milestone.
guidance.when_to_skip: No justified shipment is needed or admitted cargo/request handling is absent.
live_checks: Live cargo limits, actual target requirements and supported request/launch controls.
Source reserves, destination acceptance and observed preparation/delivery cost.
steps: Separate essential milestone construction from routine replenishment and speculative stock.
Choose supported shipments using current payload facts and the benefit at the destination.
Verify native arrival and intended use; a requested or launched shipment is not proof of delivery.
completion: The useful shipment reaches its intended destination without starving required origin service.
required_capabilities: Admitted cargo selection/request, launch and destination receipt inspection.

known_failure_modes: A remembered payload limit becomes a stored rule.
Launch admission is mistaken for completed useful delivery.

basis: Authored decision procedure; use requires live applicability and supported tools. Difficulty is independent of evidence. No autonomous gameplay capability is established.

skills.name: Protect Both Ends of a Supply Route
skills.summary: A destination depends on intermittent deliveries from another operating region. Both regions retain their required service while the intended deliveries continue.

preconditions.subject: live-applicability
preconditions.description: Check live capability, current goal, actor/surface and tool availability; an entry does not grant execution or plan authority.

constraints.description: No stored recipes or ratios. Use fresh live tools. Preserve native mechanics, owner structures, committed semantics, reservations and harness recovery limits. Reconcile uncertain effects before further mutation.

guidance.when_to_use: A destination depends on intermittent deliveries from another operating region.
guidance.when_to_skip: No cross-region dependency exists or existing service already proves the demand window.
live_checks: Live origin/destination demand, reserves and completed replenishment delays.
Actual route service capacity, interruptions and owner-designated protected stock.
steps: Read continuing local needs at both ends before classifying material as surplus.
Plan supported export and destination reserves from observed demand and service delays.
Verify replenishment at the destination and continued operation at the source; disclose unknown interruption tolerance.
completion: Both regions retain their required service while the intended deliveries continue.
required_capabilities: Admitted delivery and current origin/destination inventory/service observations.

known_failure_modes: Exports consume the origin inventory needed to make the next shipment.
A destination buffer is sized from a guessed travel time.

basis: Authored decision procedure; use requires live applicability and supported tools. Difficulty is independent of evidence. No autonomous gameplay capability is established.

skills.name: Optimize Network-Wide Progress
skills.summary: Planning authority permits choosing among several useful research, logistics or expansion milestones. The authorized investment improves evidenced progress toward the unchanged user result.

preconditions.subject: live-applicability
preconditions.description: Check live capability, current goal, actor/surface and tool availability; an entry does not grant execution or plan authority.

constraints.description: No stored recipes or ratios. Use fresh live tools. Preserve native mechanics, owner structures, committed semantics, reservations and harness recovery limits. Reconcile uncertain effects before further mutation.

guidance.when_to_use: Planning authority permits choosing among several useful research, logistics or expansion milestones.
guidance.when_to_skip: A healthy committed step already determines the next work or another region cannot be observed.
live_checks: Current user goal, immutable committed-plan boundaries and actual standing authority.
Fresh cross-region dependencies, supported capacities, unlock options and logistics costs.
steps: Identify the global dependency currently delaying the requested result.
Compare supported next milestones using live expected benefit and acquisition/service cost rather than a fixed planet or research order.
Select at an authorized planning boundary and verify useful final progress; a guide never grants permission to replace a committed plan.
completion: The authorized investment improves evidenced progress toward the unchanged user result.
required_capabilities: Fresh supported observations of the regions involved in the decision.

known_failure_modes: A local efficiency gain is mistaken for network-wide progress.
A strategy guide becomes authority to abandon the active goal or plan.

basis: Authored decision procedure; use requires live applicability and supported tools. Difficulty is independent of evidence. No autonomous gameplay capability is established.
